title: Data Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Data Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.
  

**Must have skills :** Amazon Web Services (AWS)  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education AWS Neptune must have  

  

Summary:
  

As a Data Engineer, your typical day involves designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions that support the generation, collection, and processing of data. You will be responsible for creating efficient data pipelines that facilitate seamless data flow across various systems. Ensuring the accuracy and quality of data is a key part of your role, along with implementing extract, transform, and load processes to migrate and deploy data effectively. Your work enables smooth data operations that support broader organizational goals and data\-driven decision\-making.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Monitor and optimize data workflows to improve performance and reliability.
* Document data processes and maintain clear communication with stakeholders.
* Assist junior team members in understanding data engineering concepts and best practices.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Neptune.
* Experience with designing and implementing data pipelines and ETL processes.
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-based data storage and processing solutions.
* Ability to ensure data quality through validation and cleansing techniques.
* Familiarity with data migration strategies and deployment across distributed systems.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS).


\- This position is based at our DDC5E \- SEZ location.  

* A 15 years full time education AWS Neptune must have is required.

  

15 years full time education AWS Neptune must have

title: Sr Test Engineer - Automation (Selenium + Java + Playwright +AI Testing)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**  

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  

  

**About the role:**  

Gartner is looking for a well\-rounded and motivated test engineer to join its agile, scrum\-based Sales and Services technology team which is responsible for testing web, agentic and API applications and integrations to support its continuous delivery. You will contribute to maintenance and development of test automation frameworks and leverage AI tools for testing deliverables. This role requires technical skills and a collaborative approach in a fast\-paced Agile environment
  

  

**What you will do:**

* Develop and maintain quality assurance plans, test data, procedures, and scripts.
* Ability to execute functional testing along with an ability to identify opportunities for automation and create scripts. Design, build, and maintain effective test automation solutions which meet requirements and specifications. (Smoke, Functional, Regression, etc.)
* Leverage AI\-driven tools and techniques to strengthen both manual and automated testing workflows — including AI\-assisted test case generation, intelligent test execution, and automated result and support the validation of internally built AI agents
* Exposure to web technologies
* Ensure accurate and complete converges of designated test areas.
* Write effective manual/automated test scripts within the framework of approved testing tools using documented requirements and technical specifications provided by project team
* Provide test status, document defects and potential risks
* Effectively document defects using automated defect tracking software.
* Understand new product requirements and coordinate work across multiple project phases or complex assignments.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to balance quality, timelines, and resource constraints to deliver high\-quality products.

**What you will need :**  

Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in testing applications via both manual and automated tests. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem\-solving skills along with high level of ownership and accountability. Ability to work in a collaborative team environment with good interpersonal skills.
  

  

**Must have:**

* 4\-6 years’ experience in an IT or Business environment testing highly scalable applications with significant experience designing automation platforms and writing automated tests
* **Proficiency in automating web applications across platforms using test automation tools and frameworks, including Selenium, TestNG, Playwright and/or Pytest test framework.**
* **Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Jmeter), including an ability to customize the code for load test creation.**
* **Well\-versed in Java/Git Source control.**
* **Experience in writing SQL queries, procedures, and function.**
* **Knowledge of Salesforce platform and database validation using SOQL**
* Hands on experience testing web services
* **Strong exposure to AI\-driven or agentic testing approaches leveraging multiple AI models**
* Expertise in QA prompt engineering, including designing and optimizing prompts to effectively drive AI agents for test generation, execution, and validation
* Able to independently support projects and work with various stakeholders

**What you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast\-paced AGILE\-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software testing and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.


\#LI\-SS9


**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.

title: Security Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).  

  

You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second\-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.  

Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.  

  

As a go\-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
* Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
* Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
* Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
* Client\-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or relevant work experience.
**Workplace type****:**

On\-site Working **About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune


Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with


unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as


established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each


year in R\&D.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 **Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**


NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for a **Data Quality Engineer** to build ETL/ELT solutions and DWH/DB systems at scale. You will create Python\- and SQL\-based test automation, validate DWH/Data Lake pipelines, and embed checks into CI/CD workflows across cloud data services.

**Responsibilities**

* Design automated test scripts to validate ETL workflows and data pipeline behavior
* Execute end\-to\-end data validation, reconciliation, and DWH/DB testing across large datasets
* Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to align test strategies with data quality standards
* Build reusable, scalable test automation frameworks using Python and SQL
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and delivery
* Validate data transformation logic and completeness across Azure, AWS, and GCP platforms
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and story grooming

**Requirements**

* Professional experience of 4\-6 years in data quality engineering, including ETL automation and Data Warehouse/Data Lake testing
* Strong command of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and test automation routines
* Hands\-on knowledge of Python for scripting, utilities, and framework development
* Practical experience with one or more Test Automation Frameworks
* Working exposure to Cloud Data Services across Azure (ADF, ADB), AWS (Glue, Lambda, Redshift), and GCP (BigQuery)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools and practices, including Jenkins, Git, and Azure DevOps
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and iterative delivery

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data observability or data quality tools such as Great Expectations or Deequ
* Basic knowledge of data governance and metadata management concepts
* Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, or GCP

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
